Account notes:
- Company: AtlasLoop Labs — mid-market SaaS (product orchestration for customer success and internal ops).
- Users: product + engineering + ops (small platform team).
- Primary workload: agentic chat that 1) searches internal KB, 2) synthesizes answer, 3) triggers actions (create ticket, escalate), multi-step tool pipelines.
- Latency SLO: customer wants 1st-token streaming latency consistently <= 300ms for US users; p95 generation latency target ~600ms for multi-step flows.
- Reliability concern: tool-calling reliability and deterministic retries. They flagged timeouts when agent chains search->action (seen in POC run 2026-03-04).
- Scale: typical peak concurrent users 200-400, estimated monthly token volume ~150M-400M during ramp.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market price pressure; wants TCO for Hosted vs Dedicated incl. burst capacity pricing and preemptible/GPU mix.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration, EU data residency for some enterprise customers.
- Preference: start on Hosted API (fast integration + streaming) then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput once live.
- Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "We need predictable latency for the agent — if tool-calls add 300ms variance we lose trust with CS reps."
- POC success criteria (draft): 1) streaming first-byte <300ms p95, 2) tool call success rate >= 99.5% when chained, 3) end-to-end median completion time for common triage flow <1.2s, 4) cost per resolved ticket < $0.75.
- SE notes: try prefix caching for repeated KB hits, recommend KV cache for session tokens and routing to Dedicated when sustained throughput > X.
- Docs linked: pricing deck (atlasloop-dedicated-quote.pdf), security FAQ (shared), sample canary mapping for fallback policy.
- Next ops ask: confirm SLA for streaming, recommended retry/backoff patterns for function calls, and explicit guidance on request timeouts vs tool timeouts.
